prompt:
You are a credit rating analyst. Using only the information below and general knowledge predating 2026-04-30, assign the issuer a letter credit rating on the 21-grade scale below (finest granularity you can justify).
Valid answers (choose exactly one): AAA, AA+, AA, AA-, A+, A, A-, BBB+, BBB, BBB-, BB+, BB, BB-, B+, B, B-, CCC+, CCC, CCC-, CC, C.
Company information (as of 2026-04-30):
Fiscal period 2026 Q1 (filed 2026-04-30). Revenue 181,519M, gross margin 52%, operating income 23,852M (operating margin 13%), net income 30,255M, diluted EPS 2.78. Total assets 916,630M, total liabilities 474,716M, shareholders' equity 441,914M. Current assets 255,155M vs current liabilities 216,756M (current ratio 1.18), retained earnings 280,791M.
Reason briefly in 1-3 sentences. Then, on a separate final line, output exactly:
DECISION: <one label>
raw_response:
The provided financial metrics reflect exceptional scale, profitability (high margins and net income), and balance-sheet strength (large equity cushion, solid current ratio, substantial retained earnings), consistent with a top-tier investment-grade credit having minimal default risk.
DECISION: AA+
